lines.t: Hear the ground shake, hear the light alight, truth doesn't whisper anymore, it's there.
The world painted crowns out of dust and breath
Called it life while it walked toward death
They traded truth for comfort and noise
But the still small voice cuts through the void
Not raised by men, not bent by time
The word stood firm before the line
He walked it clean, no double face
Obedience lived, not just spoken grace
Strip the names, remove the mask
Truth survives every test they cast
Not religion, not man's decree
But the living way that still walks free
The truth stands unmoved
When kingdoms fall and voices fade
The truth stands unmoved
Unchanged, unborn, unafraid
Through fire, through war, through the age of lies
The work still lives, the kingdom rises
He kept the commands they tried to erase
Walk them in love, not cold display
Touch the broken, correct the kings
Never bow to the world's cheap things
They called him threat, they called him wrong
But truth doesn't bend when the crowd sings along
The narrow way still cuts straight through
Few will walk it, but it's true
Repent means turn, not say a phrase
Change your feet, not just your face
One road back
Hear the ground shake
Hear the light alight
Truth doesn't whisper anymore
It's there

Wide rope packed, souls asleep
Truth costs everything you keep
Commandments living, written inside
Not changed, their breath, their life, their light
No blend, no mix with the world's applause
He walked it clean, now choose the call
Tear down the idols, burn the disguise
Truth doesn't fear, open eyes
He didn't cut the platter, the prog

Joshua
